title: AttnSR: Attention Step Reward for Long-Horizon Agentic RL
title_zh: AttnSR：面向长程智能体强化学习的注意力步骤奖励

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon LLM agents make multi-step decisions, yet outcome-reward-only reinforcement learning provides little direct supervision for individual steps. We introduce AttnSR , a step-level reward augmentation method that derives reward allocations from policy attention extracted during training replay, without a separately trained reward model or additional rollouts. AttnSR traces backward through the policy model attention graph to estimate the relevance of earlier steps to the final response. The terminal step, measured relative to a running baseline, determines whether these rewards reinforce or penalize the selected steps. In a controlled Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct study, AttnSR consistently outperforms the PPO baseline across all evaluated checkpoints on ALFWorld , raising final held-out success from 91.2% to 97.1%. The ablation experiment shows that the benefit depends on how intermediate rewards are assigned, rather than simple accumulation of step rewards over time. AttnSR also improves ScienceWorld at every checkpoint while cutting environment interactions by 29.9%. These results support policy attention as a practical prior for step-level reward allocation in long-horizon agentic RL. Code is available at https://github.com/fairyshine/AttnSR .
paragraphs.zh: 长时程 LLM 智能体需要做出多步决策，然而仅依赖结果奖励的强化学习几乎无法为单步提供直接监督。 我们提出 AttnSR，这是一种步级奖励增强方法，它从训练重放期间提取的策略注意力中推导奖励分配，无需单独训练奖励模型，也无需额外的轨迹采样。 AttnSR 通过策略模型的注意力图进行反向追踪，以估计早期步骤与最终响应的相关性。 终端步骤相对于运行基线的表现决定这些奖励是强化还是惩罚所选步骤。 在受控的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 实验中，AttnSR 在 ALFWorld 上所有评估检查点均持续优于 PPO 基线，将最终留出集成功率从 91.2% 提升至 97.1%。 消融实验表明，这一收益取决于中间奖励的分配方式，而非简单的步级奖励随时间的累积。 AttnSR 在 ScienceWorld 的每个检查点上也均有提升，同时将环境交互次数减少了 29.9%。 这些结果支持将策略注意力作为长时程智能体强化学习中步级奖励分配的实用先验。 代码已发布于 https://github.com/fairyshine/AttnSR 。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards ( Shao et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) is increasingly applied to agents that interleave reasoning and tool use ( Putta et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Yao et al., 2023 ) . In environments such as ALFWorld , WebShop , and ScienceWorld , agents make sequences of decisions to complete a task ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ; Yao et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2022 ) . Vanilla PPO uses the outcome reward to estimate value targets and policy advantages ( Schulman et al., 2017 ; Schulman et al., 2016 ) , but says little about how intermediate actions contribute. Assigning credit to earlier decisions thus remains a core challenge in long-horizon RL ( Zhang, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）（Shao et al., 2024；DeepSeek-AI, 2025）正越来越多地应用于交错进行推理与工具使用的智能体（Putta et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025b；Yao et al., 2023）。 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 等环境中，智能体通过一系列决策来完成任务（Shridhar et al., 2021；Yao et al., 2022；Wang et al., 2022）。 标准 PPO 使用结果奖励来估计价值目标和策略优势（Schulman et al., 2017；Schulman et al., 2016），但对中间动作如何做出贡献却几乎没有说明。 因此，如何为较早的决策分配信用仍然是长程强化学习中的一项核心挑战（Zhang, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Step-level rewards address this challenge by providing more localized training signals, but obtaining them can require step annotations, additional environment interactions, or a separately trained evaluator ( Lightman et al., 2024 ; Setlur et al., 2024 ; Kazemnejad et al., 2025 ) . This motivates using signals already available within the policy model to guide intermediate rewards, without incurring the substantial training and environment-interaction costs.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤级奖励通过提供更局部化的训练信号来解决这一挑战，但获取步骤级奖励可能需要步骤标注、额外的环境交互，或单独训练的评估器（Lightman et al., 2024；Setlur et al., 2024；Kazemnejad et al., 2025）。 这促使我们利用策略模型内部已有的信号来引导中间奖励，而无需承担高昂的训练与环境交互成本。

paragraphs.en: Attention patterns in the policy model may provide such a signal, since they record how later decisions attend to earlier actions and observations. We hypothesize that these relationships provide a useful prior for allocating intermediate rewards, although attention alone does not establish causal contributions ( Jain and Wallace, 2019 ; Abnar and Zuidema, 2020 ) . The signal can be extracted during the existing forward pass of the policy model over collected trajectories. The method adds little computation and requires neither a separate attribution backward pass nor a learned progress estimator.
paragraphs.zh: 策略模型中的注意力模式可以提供这样的信号，因为它们记录了后续决策如何关注先前的动作和观察。 我们假设这些关系为分配中间奖励提供了有用的先验，尽管仅凭注意力并不能确立因果贡献（Jain and Wallace, 2019；Abnar and Zuidema, 2020）。 该信号可以在策略模型对已收集轨迹进行的现有前向传播过程中提取。 该方法几乎不增加计算量，既不需要单独的归因反向传播，也不需要学习进度估计器。

paragraphs.en: Building on this hypothesis, we introduce Attention Step Reward ( AttnSR ), which uses the attention of the policy model to identify relevant earlier steps and turns the task outcome into intermediate training signals. Starting from the final step, it traces attention links backward to estimate the relevance of earlier actions and observations. These estimates determine which intermediate steps receive reward, while weaker or less consistent attention reduces their overall magnitude. Outcomes above the running average score yield positive intermediate rewards, and those below it yield negative rewards. These signals can in principle be used directly by step-level RL algorithms or placed at assistant-step endpoints for token-level RL. We study the latter integration in PPO, where the added rewards change value targets and policy advantages while retaining the critic architecture and losses.
paragraphs.zh: 在该假设的基础上，我们提出注意力步骤奖励（Attention Step Reward，AttnSR），它利用策略模型的注意力识别相关的较早步骤，并将任务结果转化为中间训练信号。 它从最终步骤出发，沿注意力链接向后追溯，以估计较早动作和观察的相关性。 这些估计决定了哪些中间步骤获得奖励，而较弱或不一致的注意力会降低奖励的整体幅度。 结果高于运行平均分时产生正向中间奖励，低于运行平均分时产生负向奖励。 这些信号原则上可以直接用于步骤级强化学习算法，也可以放置在助手步骤端点处用于词元级强化学习。 我们在 PPO 中研究了后一种集成方式，其中新增的奖励会改变价值目标和策略优势，同时保留评论家网络的结构和损失函数。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate AttnSR on ALFWorld , ScienceWorld , and WebShop using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with matched token-level PPO training. ALFWorld success rises from 91.2% to 97.1%, with larger gains on unseen tasks, whereas the positional ablation reaches 92.3%. On ScienceWorld, AttnSR yields higher official scores at all four reported checkpoints and 29.9% fewer mean environment steps. These results suggest that policy attention can serve as a useful signal for intermediate reward allocation, offering a way to enrich outcome-based supervision without additional rollouts or a separately trained reward model.

Based on this hypothesis, we use attention-derived dependencies to distribute outcome information across steps for temporal credit assignment, treating attention as a heuristic relevance signal, not evidence of causal contribution.

paragraphs.en: We introduce AttnSR , a step-level reward augmentation scheme that combines attention-based allocation, confidence gating, and outcome centering. The signals can be used directly as step-level rewards or aligned with assistant-step endpoints for token-level objectives, and we study the latter integration with PPO. It needs neither counterfactual rollouts nor a separately trained reward model.

paragraphs.en: We model each LLM-based agent interaction trajectory as a multi-turn conversation. Episode i i starts from a task query and contains K i K_{i} decision steps. Each step S i , k S_{i,k} comprises an assistant message A i , k A_{i,k} and its environment observation O i , k O_{i,k} when present, and the final message may have no observation. Let ℐ i , k \mathcal{I}_{i,k} be the assistant token indices at step k k , and e i , k ∈ ℐ i , k e_{i,k}\in\mathcal{I}_{i,k} its last trainable token, the step endpoint . We supply PPO with a task outcome reward R i ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] R_{i}\in[0,1] . In the canonical runs, R i R_{i} is binary success for ALFWorld , the normalized official score for WebShop , and the normalized final score for ScienceWorld . Format-error trajectories receive R i = 0 R_{i}=0 . paragraphs.en: We use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) with a frozen base model and rank-64 LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) for actor and critic. Figure 2 shows how detached actor attention changes policy advantages and value targets through intermediate rewards, retaining the PPO losses. We evaluate after each of four data epochs. Training uses VeRL ( Sheng et al., 2025 ) , Megatron ( Shoeybi et al., 2019 ) , and vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) on 8 × \times H200 GPUs (140 GB each), with a 32,768-token context and no additional per-turn token or turn-count cap. paragraphs.en: We decode greedily once per held-out task and report full-set metrics. The WebShop validation split is reserved for training-time validation. The main comparison uses epoch 4 without selecting the best test-set checkpoint. Format errors violate the required tool-call protocol and receive outcome reward zero without an additional training penalty. For statistical comparisons, exact-input matching retains all 274 ALFWorld and 500 WebShop tasks and 1,488 of 1,819 ScienceWorld tasks, as described in Appendix E . A two-sided exact McNemar test ( McNemar, 1947 ) assesses binary success differences, and a paired bootstrap ( Efron, 1979 ) with 10,000 resamples estimates 95% percentile intervals for success-rate and official-score differences. paragraphs.en: Language agents interleave reasoning with actions ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Putta et al., 2024 ) , each spanning multiple tokens. This creates a distinction between token-level optimization and step-level credit assignment. POAD decomposes Bellman backups within and across actions ( Wen et al., 2024 ) , ArCHer pairs a turn-level critic with a token-level actor ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , and GiGPO groups steps with matching anchor states to estimate critic-free relative advantages ( Feng et al., 2025 ) . These methods address the granularity of value or advantage estimation. AttnSR instead intervenes at the reward interface. It assigns outcome-conditioned rewards to interaction steps, which then enter the target computation of RL algorithms. In our token-level PPO implementation, these rewards are placed at assistant-step endpoints and propagated through GAE ( Schulman et al., 2017 ; Schulman et al., 2016 ) , retaining the critic architecture and optimization losses. We evaluate this reward interface in PPO and separately test attention-based token-advantage reweighting in GRPO.
paragraphs.zh: 语言智能体将推理与动作交替进行（Yao et al., 2023；Putta et al., 2024），每一部分都跨越多个 token。 这造成了 token 级优化与步骤级信用分配之间的区别。 POAD 在动作内和动作间分解 Bellman 备份（Wen et al., 2024），ArCHer 将回合级评论家与 token 级执行者配对（Zhou et al., 2024），GiGPO 将具有匹配锚定状态的步骤分组以估计无评论家的相对优势（Feng et al., 2025）。 这些方法解决的是价值或优势估计的粒度问题。 AttnSR 则是在奖励接口处进行干预。 它为交互步骤分配以结果为条件的奖励，这些奖励随后进入 RL 算法的目标计算。 在我们的 token 级 PPO 实现中，这些奖励被放置在 assistant 步骤的末端，并通过 GAE（Schulman et al., 2017；Schulman et al., 2016）进行传播，同时保留评论家架构和优化损失。 我们在 PPO 中评估这一奖励接口，并在 GRPO 中单独测试基于注意力的 token 优势重加权。

paragraphs.en: Long horizons and partial observability complicate credit assignment from terminal outcomes ( Zhang, 2026 ) . VinePPO estimates intermediate values through Monte Carlo rollouts ( Kazemnejad et al., 2025 ) , AgentPRM learns step-level promise and progress ( Xi et al., 2025 ) , TARL uses an LLM judge for turn-level process supervision ( Tan et al., 2025 ) , and SWEET-RL trains an evaluator with privileged information ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . Process supervision also uses step annotations ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) , estimated progress ( Setlur et al., 2024 ) , or trajectory preferences ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Other approaches use counterfactual baselines ( Foerster et al., 2018 ) , hindsight estimators ( Tan et al., 2026 ) , learned progress in SPA-RL ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , or gradient saliency in ACPO ( Yin et al., 2025 ) . FlowTracer derives token credit from answer-targeted information flow on an attention-induced graph ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . AttnSR draws its allocation prior from actor attention, avoiding additional environment rollouts, a separately trained large reward model, or an attribution backward pass. This signal expresses relevance rather than verified causal importance ( Jain and Wallace, 2019 ; Abnar and Zuidema, 2020 ) . Confidence gating moderates its strength, while the centered outcome determines its sign. Unlike return-preserving redistribution in RUDDER ( Arjona-Medina et al., 2019 ) , AttnSR retains the outcome reward and adds intermediate rewards. It thus changes the return without guaranteeing policy invariance, and we evaluate on the original metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 长时程与部分可观测性使得从终止结果进行信用分配变得复杂（Zhang, 2026）。 VinePPO 通过蒙特卡洛展开估计中间价值（Kazemnejad et al., 2025），AgentPRM 学习步骤级的前景与进展（Xi et al., 2025），TARL 使用 LLM 评审进行轮次级过程监督（Tan et al., 2025），SWEET-RL 则利用特权信息训练评估器（Zhou et al., 2025）。 过程监督还使用步骤标注（Lightman et al., 2024）、估计的进展（Setlur et al., 2024）或轨迹偏好（Liu et al., 2025）。 其他方法使用反事实基线（Foerster et al., 2018）、后见之明估计器（Tan et al., 2026）、SPA-RL 中学习到的进展（Wang et al., 2025a），或 ACPO 中的梯度显著性（Yin et al., 2025）。 FlowTracer 在注意力诱导图上从面向答案的信息流中推导词元级信用（Dong et al., 2026）。 AttnSR 从智能体的注意力中获取分配先验，从而避免额外的环境展开、单独训练的大型奖励模型或归因反向传播。 这一信号表达的是相关性，而非经过验证的因果重要性（Jain and Wallace, 2019；Abnar and Zuidema, 2020）。 置信度门控调节该信号的强度，而中心化的结果决定其符号。 与 RUDDER 中保持回报不变的重分配方式（Arjona-Medina et al., 2019）不同，AttnSR 保留结果奖励并在此基础上添加中间奖励。 因此它改变了回报，却不保证策略不变性，我们仍在原始指标上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: AttnSR allocates outcome-conditioned rewards using actor attention, without extra rollouts or a learned reward model. With PPO, ALFWorld success rises from 91.2% to 97.1%, exceeding the linear control. ScienceWorld shows numerical gains with fewer interactions, while WebShop has no statistically detectable gain. Supplementary experiments show gains under both PPO and a GRPO token-advantage reweighting variant, with one training run per method. Future work will extend the evaluation to longer context lengths and interaction horizons, examining how attention-based credit allocation handles action dependencies spanning more distant steps.

paragraphs.en: This work studies training methods for simulated text-based agents. The experiments use benchmark environments and do not involve human subjects or collection of personal data. As with other agent-training methods, improved planning and tool-use capability could be transferred to applications with unintended consequences. Deployment should thus include task-specific safeguards and monitoring.

paragraphs.en: On ALFWorld, the verified pairs include 20 tasks solved only by AttnSR, 4 only by PPO, 246 by both, and 4 by neither. paragraphs.en: Our ALFWorld adaptations of TARL ( Tan et al., 2025 ) , AgentPRM ( Xi et al., 2025 ) , and FlowTracer ( Dong et al., 2026 ) are trained independently from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with LoRA for four data epochs. We evaluate the final checkpoints at update 1,776 on all 274 held-out ALFWorld tasks (140 seen and 134 unseen), using one greedy rollout per task and a 32,768-token context. The implementation variants recorded in the experiment inventory are TARL-Turn, AgentPRM-Progress, and FlowTracer-PPO, respectively. Table 1 (b) retains the canonical PPO and AttnSR results as references, and no paired significance comparison with the three additional methods is claimed.
